Resource.Name: Project Manager – Shah Masoom Kshitij
Resource.Notes: Leads the project; chairs meetings; Sponsor liaison; change control; risk and issue management.

Resource.Name: Planning Coordinator – Adeniji Adekunle
Resource.Notes: Maintains the schedule baseline and project file; event pipeline and booking calendar; runs coordination meetings.

Resource.Name: Finance Head – Alain Rivera Sanchez
Resource.Notes: Budget, procurement and contracts; supplier quotes and payments; insurance and WSIB evidence.

Resource.Name: Deliverables Analyst – Himanshu Verma
Resource.Notes: Deliverables and compliance lead; validates requirements; permits and inspections; quality checks; staff compliance records.

Resource.Name: Project Sponsor – Nessen Ramsamy
Resource.Notes: Approves scope, baselines, menu and pricing, go/no-go and handover; removes obstacles; approver time only.

Resource.Name: Kitchen Lead (restaurant chef)
Resource.Notes: Menu and costing; kitchen workflow input; food-preparation training; supply quantities.

Resource.Name: Restaurant Operations Lead
Resource.Notes: Supply and inventory; loading, towing and set-up procedures; crew scheduling; POS operating requirements.

Resource.Name: Marketing and Social Media Coordinator
Resource.Notes: Brand content; website profile and booking form; social media and announcements; pilot promotion.

Resource.Name: Event Cook / Grill Operator
Resource.Notes: Cooks and operates the grill; trained and certified for food handling; readiness testing and pilot service.

Resource.Name: Event Cashier / POS Operator
Resource.Notes: Takes orders and payments; POS user testing; readiness testing and pilot service.

Resource.Name: Event Customer-Service Attendant
Resource.Notes: Customer service and order hand-off; readiness testing and pilot service.

Resource.Name: Trailer and Equipment Supplier
Resource.Notes: Supplies and delivers the trailer and major equipment.

Resource.Name: Fit-Out Contractor (installation crew)
Resource.Notes: Installs kitchen equipment and fixtures (two-person crew).

Resource.Name: Licensed Trades Contractor (gas / electrical / plumbing)
Resource.Notes: TSSA-certified gas and propane, ESA-licensed electrical, plumbing and fire-suppression installation (two-person crew).

Resource.Name: POS Vendor Technician
Resource.Notes: Supplies, installs and configures POS hardware, network and software.

Resource.Name: Graphic Designer and Wrap Installer
Resource.Notes: Designs and installs the exterior wrap, signage and menu displays.
